questions.question: Order 3,457 m, 3,5 m and 3,45 m from longest to shortest and explain your method.
questions.expected_answer: Write all with three decimal places: 3,457; 3,500; 3,450. Compare from the left: tenths 4, 5, 4, so 3,5 is longest; then thousandths 7 vs 0. Order: 3,5 m, 3,457 m, 3,45 m.

questions.question: Give the value of each digit in 3,457 and explain why 3,10 does not come after 3,9.
questions.expected_answer: 3 units, 4 tenths, 5 hundredths, 7 thousandths. 3,10 equals 3,1, which is less than 3,9; ten tenths make a whole, so after 3,9 comes 4,0.

questions.question: Round 3,457 to two and to one decimal place, and 2,996 to two decimal places.
questions.expected_answer: 3,457 ≈ 3,46 (next digit 7) and ≈ 3,5 (next digit 5). 2,996 ≈ 3,00 because rounding the 9 hundredths up carries into the units.
